examples.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the class vote.
examples.zh: 每位候選人在班級投票前都發表了一段簡短的演說。

examples.en: The company interviewed five candidates for the sales position.
examples.zh: 公司為業務職位面試了五位應試者。

examples.en: She is a strong candidate for the scholarship this year.
examples.zh: 她是今年獎學金的有力人選。

examples.en: My grandfather walks with a cane after his knee surgery.
examples.zh: 我爺爺膝蓋手術後拄著手杖走路。

examples.en: The old chair was made of cane and wood.
examples.zh: 這張舊椅子是用藤條和木頭做成的。

examples.en: Farmers cut the cane by hand before sending it to the factory.
examples.zh: 農夫先用手割下甘蔗莖，再送到工廠。

examples.en: We rented a canoe and paddled across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我們租了一艘獨木舟，划過平靜的湖面。

examples.en: The canoe was too small for four adults.
examples.zh: 這艘獨木舟對四個大人來說太小了。

examples.en: He learned to steer a canoe at summer camp.
examples.zh: 他在夏令營學會了如何操控獨木舟。

examples.en: They plan to canoe down the river this weekend.
examples.zh: 他們計畫這個週末划獨木舟順流而下。

examples.en: We canoed for three hours before stopping for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們划了三個小時的獨木舟才停下來吃午餐。

examples.en: Do you want to canoe with us on Saturday?
examples.zh: 你星期六想和我們一起去划獨木舟嗎？

examples.en: The stadium has a capacity of fifty thousand people.
examples.zh: 這座體育場的容納量是五萬人。

examples.en: Her capacity for hard work impressed everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 她努力工作的能力讓辦公室裡的每個人都印象深刻。

examples.en: The factory is running at full capacity this month.
examples.zh: 這間工廠這個月正以滿載產能運轉。

examples.en: The capitalist invested a large sum in the new company.
examples.zh: 這位資本家把一大筆錢投資在新公司上。

examples.en: Some capitalists believe the market should have few rules.
examples.zh: 有些資本主義者認為市場的規範應該越少越好。

examples.en: The book tells the story of a young capitalist in the 1900s.
examples.zh: 這本書講述一位二十世紀初年輕資本家的故事。

examples.en: Taiwan has a capitalist economy based on free trade.
examples.zh: 台灣的經濟是以自由貿易為基礎的資本主義經濟。

examples.en: The teacher compared capitalist and socialist systems in class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上比較了資本主義與社會主義制度。

examples.en: Many capitalist countries use taxes to support public schools.
examples.zh: 許多資本主義國家用稅收來支持公立學校。

examples.en: The ship carried a cargo of rice from Thailand.
examples.zh: 這艘船載運了一批來自泰國的稻米。

examples.en: Workers unloaded the cargo at the harbor this morning.
examples.zh: 工人今天早上在港口卸下貨物。

examples.en: The plane has extra space for cargo in the back.
examples.zh: 這架飛機的後方有額外的貨物空間。

examples.en: He likes to carve small animals out of wood.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用木頭雕刻小動物。

examples.en: Dad will carve the turkey at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 爸爸會在餐桌上切開火雞肉。

examples.en: She worked hard to carve a career in the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 她努力在時尚產業中開創自己的事業。

examples.en: The noise will cease when the machine is turned off.
examples.zh: 機器關掉後，噪音就會停止。

examples.en: The company ceased production after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，公司就停止了生產。

examples.en: Please cease talking and open your textbooks to page ten.
examples.zh: 請停止說話，把課本翻到第十頁。

examples.en: The whole town joined the celebration of the new year.
examples.zh: 全鎮的人都參加了新年的慶祝活動。

examples.en: We had a small celebration for my sister's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們為姊姊的生日辦了一場小小的慶祝會。

examples.en: There will be a celebration after the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考之後會有一場慶祝活動。

examples.en: The king waited for the guests in his private chamber.
examples.zh: 國王在他的私人寢室裡等候客人。

examples.en: The new law passed in the upper chamber yesterday.
examples.zh: 新法律昨天在上議院通過了。

examples.en: The heart has four chambers that pump blood through the body.
examples.zh: 心臟有四個腔室，負責把血液送往全身。

examples.en: Our school team won the basketball championship last year.
examples.zh: 我們學校的隊伍去年贏得了籃球錦標賽。

examples.en: The championship will be held in Taipei next month.
examples.zh: 這場錦標賽下個月將在台北舉行。

examples.en: She trained for years to win the national championship.
examples.zh: 她訓練多年，只為贏得全國冠軍頭銜。

examples.en: Kindness is the most important characteristic of a good teacher.
examples.zh: 親切是好老師最重要的特質。

examples.en: Each animal has its own special characteristics.
examples.zh: 每種動物都有自己獨特的特徵。

examples.en: A long neck is a characteristic of giraffes.
examples.zh: 長脖子是長頸鹿的特徵。

examples.en: The cake had the characteristic taste of fresh lemons.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕有新鮮檸檬特有的味道。

examples.en: Her characteristic smile made everyone feel welcome.
examples.zh: 她那獨特的笑容讓每個人都覺得受到歡迎。

examples.en: Loud laughter is characteristic of my uncle.
examples.zh: 大聲的笑是我叔叔的典型特色。

examples.en: She gives part of her salary to a local charity.
examples.zh: 她把部分薪水捐給當地的慈善機構。

examples.en: The school held a concert to raise money for charity.
examples.zh: 學校舉辦音樂會為慈善活動募款。

examples.en: He does not want charity; he wants a fair job.
examples.zh: 他不想要施捨，他想要的是一份公平的工作。

examples.en: I will always cherish the time I spent with my grandmother.
examples.zh: 我會永遠珍惜與奶奶相處的時光。

examples.en: She cherishes the old photo her father gave her.
examples.zh: 她很珍視爸爸送給她的那張老照片。

examples.en: Many students cherish the hope of studying abroad.
examples.zh: 許多學生懷抱著出國讀書的希望。

examples.en: Please chew your food slowly before you swallow it.
examples.zh: 吞下去之前，請把食物慢慢嚼碎。

examples.en: The puppy likes to chew on my old slippers.
examples.zh: 這隻小狗喜歡咬我的舊拖鞋。

examples.en: He chewed gum all through the long bus ride.
examples.zh: 他在漫長的公車路程中一直嚼口香糖。

examples.en: The dog is busy with a chew from the pet store.
examples.zh: 這隻狗正忙著啃從寵物店買來的咬嚼玩具。

examples.en: Give the meat a good chew before you swallow.
examples.zh: 吞下去之前，先把肉好好嚼一嚼。

examples.en: This candy is a soft chew with a fruit flavor.
examples.zh: 這種糖是水果口味的軟嚼糖。

examples.en: Don't talk while eating, or you may choke.
examples.zh: 吃東西時不要說話，否則可能會噎到。

examples.en: The smoke from the kitchen began to choke the whole room.
examples.zh: 廚房冒出的煙讓整個房間開始令人喘不過氣。

examples.en: Leaves can choke the drain after a heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，落葉可能會堵住排水孔。

examples.en: She sings in the school chorus every Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她每個星期五下午都在學校合唱團唱歌。

examples.en: Everyone joined in on the chorus of the song.
examples.zh: 大家都跟著唱起這首歌的副歌。

examples.en: The students answered in chorus, "Good morning, teacher!"
examples.zh: 學生們齊聲回答：「老師早！」

examples.en: We sat around a circular table in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 我們圍坐在會議室的圓桌旁。

examples.en: The bus takes a circular route around the park.
examples.zh: 這班公車繞著公園走環形路線。

examples.en: Their argument was circular and never reached an answer.
examples.zh: 他們的爭論是在原地打轉，始終沒有答案。

examples.en: The store sent out a circular about the summer sale.
examples.zh: 這家商店寄出了夏季特賣的傳單。

examples.en: A circular from the school was in my mailbox.
examples.zh: 我的信箱裡有一份學校寄來的通告。

examples.en: Please read the circular and sign the last page.
examples.zh: 請閱讀這份通告並在最後一頁簽名。

examples.en: Blood circulates through the body many times a minute.
examples.zh: 血液每分鐘在體內循環許多次。

examples.en: Please circulate the report among all team members.
examples.zh: 請把這份報告在所有組員之間傳閱。

examples.en: A rumor about the exam began to circulate at school.
examples.zh: 一則關於考試的謠言開始在學校裡流傳。

examples.en: Walking every day improves blood circulation in the legs.
examples.zh: 每天走路能改善腿部的血液循環。

examples.en: The magazine has a circulation of about ten thousand copies.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌的發行量大約是一萬本。

examples.en: Fans in the room keep the air in circulation.
examples.zh: 房間裡的電扇讓空氣保持流通。

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you open this door.
examples.zh: 在任何情況下你都不該打開這扇門。

examples.en: The circumstances of the accident are still unclear.
examples.zh: 這起意外的情況仍不明朗。

examples.en: They lived in poor circumstances but never gave up.
examples.zh: 他們的生活環境很差，卻從未放棄。

examples.en: The museum is open to civilians on weekends.
examples.zh: 這間博物館週末開放給一般民眾參觀。

examples.en: He left the army and returned to civilian life.
examples.zh: 他離開軍隊，回到了平民生活。

examples.en: Civilians in the area were told to stay calm.
examples.zh: 該地區的民眾被告知要保持冷靜。

examples.en: The airport serves both military and civilian flights.
examples.zh: 這座機場同時供軍用與民用航班使用。

examples.en: She wore civilian clothes on her day off.
examples.zh: 她休假那天穿的是便服。

examples.en: A civilian committee will review the new plan.
examples.zh: 一個民間委員會將審查這項新計畫。

examples.en: The ancient Egyptian civilization built great pyramids.
examples.zh: 古埃及文明建造了偉大的金字塔。

examples.en: The museum shows how civilization has changed over time.
examples.zh: 這間博物館展示了文明如何隨著時間改變。

examples.en: Writing was an important step in the growth of civilization.
examples.zh: 文字的發明是文明發展中重要的一步。

examples.en: Could you clarify what you mean by this sentence?
examples.zh: 你可以說明一下這個句子是什麼意思嗎？

examples.en: The teacher clarified the rules before the game began.
examples.zh: 老師在比賽開始前把規則說明清楚。

examples.en: The manager sent an email to clarify the new schedule.
examples.zh: 經理寄了一封電子郵件來釐清新的時間表。

examples.en: There was a clash of opinions at the club meeting.
examples.zh: 社團會議上出現了意見衝突。

examples.en: The two teams had a clash over the schedule.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍為了時間表起了爭執。

examples.en: Her yellow shirt is a clash with the red skirt.
examples.zh: 她的黃襯衫和紅裙子很不搭。

examples.en: My piano lesson clashes with the English class on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我的鋼琴課和星期二的英文課時間衝突。

examples.en: The two leaders often clash over how to spend the budget.
examples.zh: 這兩位領導者經常為了如何使用預算而起衝突。

examples.en: Those bright colors clash with the old curtains.
examples.zh: 那些鮮豔的顏色和舊窗簾很不搭。

examples.en: The classification of plants is based on their leaves and flowers.
examples.zh: 植物的分類是根據葉子和花來決定的。

examples.en: Please check the classification of each book before you shelve it.
examples.zh: 把每本書上架前，請先確認它的類別。

examples.en: The library uses a simple classification system.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館使用一套簡單的分類系統。

examples.en: Scientists classify animals into groups by their features.
examples.zh: 科學家依據特徵把動物分成不同的類別。

examples.en: The librarian will classify the new books by subject.
examples.zh: 圖書館員會依主題替新書分類。

examples.en: We classified the photos by date and place.
examples.zh: 我們依日期和地點把照片歸類。

examples.en: The cat sharpened its claws on the old sofa.
examples.zh: 那隻貓在舊沙發上磨牠的爪子。

examples.en: A crab can pinch you with its large claw.
examples.zh: 螃蟹會用牠的大螯夾人。

examples.en: The eagle held the fish in its claws.
examples.zh: 老鷹用爪子抓著那條魚。

examples.en: The kitten tried to claw its way up the curtain.
examples.zh: 那隻小貓試著用爪子攀上窗簾。

examples.en: The dog began to claw at the door to go outside.
examples.zh: 那隻狗開始用爪子扒門，想出去。

examples.en: He had to claw through the thick bushes to find the path.
examples.zh: 他得用手扒開濃密的灌木叢才找得到小徑。

examples.en: We stood on the cliff and watched the waves below.
examples.zh: 我們站在懸崖上，看著下方的海浪。

examples.en: A small path runs along the edge of the cliff.
examples.zh: 一條小路沿著懸崖邊緣延伸。

examples.en: Birds built their nests on the steep cliff.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在陡峭的懸崖上築巢。

senses.zh: 笨拙的；不靈巧的；不得體的

examples.en: I am so clumsy that I spilled my drink again.
examples.zh: 我太笨手笨腳了，又把飲料打翻了。

examples.en: The clumsy waiter dropped a plate in front of the guests.
examples.zh: 那位笨手笨腳的服務生在客人面前摔了一個盤子。

examples.en: He made a clumsy excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 他為遲到編了一個很拙劣的藉口。

examples.en: The towel felt coarse against my skin.
examples.zh: 這條毛巾貼在皮膚上感覺很粗糙。

examples.en: Use coarse salt to season the meat before cooking.
examples.zh: 烹煮前用粗鹽替肉調味。

examples.en: His coarse language shocked the teachers.
examples.zh: 他粗俗的言詞讓老師們很震驚。

examples.en: Enter the secret code to open the door.
examples.zh: 輸入秘密密碼就能把門打開。

examples.en: The school has a dress code for all students.
examples.zh: 學校對所有學生都有服裝規定。

examples.en: She writes computer code for a small software company.
examples.zh: 她替一家小型軟體公司撰寫程式碼。

examples.en: My brother learned to code when he was twelve.
examples.zh: 我弟弟十二歲就學會寫程式了。

examples.en: They coded the messages so no one else could read them.
examples.zh: 他們把訊息編成密碼，這樣別人就看不懂。

examples.en: We will code the survey answers before we count them.
examples.zh: 我們會先把問卷答案編碼，再進行統計。

examples.en: The old bridge may collapse if the river keeps rising.
examples.zh: 如果河水持續上漲，這座老橋可能會倒塌。

examples.en: The runner collapsed at the finish line from the heat.
examples.zh: 那位跑者因為高溫在終點線倒下了。

examples.en: The small shop collapsed after the big store opened nearby.
examples.zh: 大型商店在附近開幕後，這間小店就倒閉了。

examples.en: The collapse of the roof surprised the neighbors.
examples.zh: 屋頂的倒塌讓鄰居們很驚訝。

examples.en: The collapse of the company hurt many workers.
examples.zh: 這間公司的垮台使許多員工受到影響。

examples.en: Doctors blamed his collapse on a lack of sleep.
examples.zh: 醫生認為他的昏倒是睡眠不足造成的。

examples.en: My colleague helped me finish the report before noon.
examples.zh: 我的同事幫我在中午前完成了報告。

examples.en: She invited a few colleagues to her birthday dinner.
examples.zh: 她邀請了幾位同事參加她的生日晚餐。

examples.en: I asked a colleague for advice about the new project.
examples.zh: 我向一位同事請教關於新專案的建議。

examples.en: Rice and beans make a healthy combination.
examples.zh: 米飯和豆子是很健康的搭配。

examples.en: The combination of rain and wind canceled the game.
examples.zh: 雨和風的加乘讓比賽取消了。

examples.en: I forgot the combination to my bike lock.
examples.zh: 我忘了腳踏車鎖的密碼組合。

examples.en: We watched a funny comedy on Saturday night.
examples.zh: 我們星期六晚上看了一部好笑的喜劇片。

examples.en: The drama club will perform a comedy next month.
examples.zh: 戲劇社下個月要演出一齣喜劇。

examples.en: Her speech was full of comedy and kept us laughing.
examples.zh: 她的演說充滿幽默，讓我們一直笑個不停。

examples.en: The commander gave clear orders to the whole team.
examples.zh: 指揮官向整個團隊下達了清楚的命令。

examples.en: A new commander arrived at the base yesterday.
examples.zh: 一位新的指揮官昨天抵達了基地。

examples.en: The commander of the ship thanked the crew.
examples.zh: 船艦的指揮官向全體船員道謝。

examples.en: Taipei is an important center of commerce in Asia.
examples.zh: 台北是亞洲重要的商業中心。

examples.en: The city grew quickly because of trade and commerce.
examples.zh: 這座城市因為貿易和商業而快速成長。

examples.en: Online commerce has changed the way we shop.
examples.zh: 網路商務改變了我們購物的方式。

examples.en: He committed an error when he added the numbers.
examples.zh: 他在加總數字時犯了一個錯誤。

examples.en: I commit to finishing the project by Friday.
examples.zh: 我承諾在星期五前完成這項專案。

examples.en: She committed herself to learning English every day.
examples.zh: 她下定決心每天學英文。

examples.en: Good communication helps a team work well together.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通能幫助團隊合作順利。

examples.en: Cell phones have made communication easier for everyone.
examples.zh: 手機讓每個人的聯絡都變得更容易。

examples.en: There was no communication between the two offices.
examples.zh: 這兩間辦公室之間沒有任何聯繫。

examples.en: Our community holds a clean-up day every spring.
examples.zh: 我們社區每年春天都會舉辦清潔日。

examples.en: The school is an important part of the community.
examples.zh: 學校是社區裡很重要的一部分。

examples.en: She joined an online community for bird lovers.
examples.zh: 她加入了一個賞鳥愛好者的網路社群。

examples.en: The dog was his loyal companion for twelve years.
examples.zh: 這隻狗陪伴了他十二年，是他忠實的夥伴。

examples.en: She found a travel companion for her trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 她找到了一位同行的旅伴，一起去日本。

examples.en: A good book can be a wonderful companion.
examples.zh: 一本好書可以是很棒的良伴。

examples.en: She won first prize in the speech competition.
examples.zh: 她在演講比賽中得到第一名。

examples.en: There is strong competition for jobs in this city.
examples.zh: 這座城市的工作競爭很激烈。

examples.en: The two stores are in competition for customers.
examples.zh: 這兩家店正在爭取客人。

senses.zh: 競爭的；好勝的；有競爭力的

examples.en: The job market is very competitive this year.
examples.zh: 今年的就業市場競爭非常激烈。

examples.en: My brother is competitive and hates to lose a game.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很好勝，討厭輸掉遊戲。

examples.en: The shop offers competitive prices on school supplies.
examples.zh: 這家店的學生用品價格很有競爭力。

examples.en: Our main competitor just lowered its prices.
examples.zh: 我們的主要競爭對手剛剛降價了。

examples.en: Each competitor must wear a number during the race.
examples.zh: 每位參賽者在比賽中都必須佩戴號碼。

examples.en: She studied her competitors before the interview.
examples.zh: 她在面試前研究了她的競爭對手。

examples.en: Too many rules will only complicate the process.
examples.zh: 太多規定只會讓流程變得複雜。

examples.en: Heavy traffic complicated our trip to the airport.
examples.zh: 嚴重的塞車讓我們前往機場的行程變得更麻煩。

examples.en: Please don't complicate things by changing the plan again.
examples.zh: 請不要再改計畫，讓事情更複雜了。

examples.en: Twelve students compose the school band.
examples.zh: 十二位學生組成了這支學校樂隊。

examples.en: He likes to compose songs on his guitar.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用吉他創作歌曲。

examples.en: She took a deep breath to compose herself before the speech.
examples.zh: 她在演講前深呼吸，讓自己鎮定下來。

examples.en: Mozart is one of the most famous composers in history.
examples.zh: 莫札特是歷史上最有名的作曲家之一。

examples.en: The composer wrote a new piece for the school orchestra.
examples.zh: 這位作曲家為學校管弦樂團寫了一首新曲子。

examples.en: My favorite composer was born in Germany.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的作曲家出生在德國。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write a short composition about summer.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於夏天的短文。

examples.en: Beethoven's last composition is still played around the world.
examples.zh: 貝多芬的最後一首作品至今仍在世界各地演奏。

examples.en: Scientists studied the chemical composition of the soil.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了土壤的化學成分。

examples.en: I can't concentrate when the room is so noisy.
examples.zh: 房間這麼吵，我沒辦法專心。

examples.en: Please concentrate on the first question of the test.
examples.zh: 請專心作答考卷的第一題。

examples.en: The city plans to concentrate new stores near the station.
examples.zh: 市府計畫把新的商店集中在車站附近。

examples.en: Mix the juice concentrate with cold water.
examples.zh: 把濃縮果汁和冷水混合。

examples.en: This soup is made from tomato concentrate.
examples.zh: 這道湯是用濃縮番茄製成的。

examples.en: Add a little concentrate to the cleaning water.
examples.zh: 在清潔用的水裡加一點濃縮液。
